english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something ordinary, common, or unexceptional.

exampleSentences.english: This is an ordinary breakfast for an office worker.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個係普通嘅上班族早餐。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 pou2 tung1 ge3 soeng6 baan1 zuk6 zou2 caan1

english.note: Use this for something ordinary or unremarkable, not specifically for something vulgar or low-class.

exampleSentences.english: The food at this restaurant is pretty common and nothing special.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好普通，冇乜特別。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 pou2 tung1 mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6

english.note: Use this for an ordinary or representative person, family, or thing rather than a calculated mean.

exampleSentences.english: I'm just an average working person.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我只係一個普通打工仔。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 daa2 gung1 zai2

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “regular” means ordinary, normal, or not special.

exampleSentences.english: The lunch at this restaurant is pretty regular.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅午餐好普通。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ng5 caan1 hou2 pou2 tung1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something ordinary or suitable for normal use rather than special occasions.

exampleSentences.english: This shirt is very ordinary and perfect for everyday wear.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢件衫好普通，平時着最啱。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 gin6 saam1 hou2 pou2 tung1 ping4 si4 zoek3 zeoi3 ngaam1

english.note: Use this for the social or aesthetic sense of “basic” as generic, mainstream, or unimpressive.

exampleSentences.english: Their look is pretty basic; I saw several people dressed the same way on the street.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢個造型好普通，行街撞到幾個一樣嘅。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 go3 zou6 jing4 hou2 pou2 tung1 haang4 gaai1 zong6 dou2 gei2 go3 jat1 joeng6 ge3
